column1: # Role registry. Tab-separated. One of the two files allowed to name concrete
# model_key identifies the weights. ctx and slots are per load.
# weights is the directory under ~/.hearth/models that oMLX serves.
# backend: omlx for a local role, or an explicit cloud backend (gemini).
# draft is "-" . The column remains so a row stays eight fields.
# load: resident → scripts/omlx.sh up keeps it loaded; demand → loaded only
# by ask-deep or scripts/demand-load.sh (ADR 0020); skipped by healthcheck and bench.
